## Task and version

Module/page/script, commit/release, OS, Python/environment, and command. Exclude credentials, private messages, and student records.

## Reproduce

Provide minimal steps using a reviewed public source or non-sensitive description. State expected and observed behavior, bounded error text, and setup followed.

## Learning impact

Which core or optional task is affected? Is there an effective alternative? A conceptual question should identify the step that remains unclear.
